items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: The interviewee clarifies the name 'Kingston' as 'Rico's Alexis' or 'Kingston's Alexis' but does not describe a personal interaction, collaboration, or relationship with this individual.

ctx.x: He was Piron number two band for a while, you see, well he played the country club, the Carolina country club, the Jewish country club, we played all that, well we played them and the country club dates, I'd say, you know, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, any night, you know, do them, but we never missed a country club, we had the country club every Saturday regular, plus, you know, the weekday again. And, uh, later, after that, I mean, they didn't play, go, actually play with Kingston or none of the Piron house?…
